views.rationale: AMZN's 24% services growth in Q4 2020 outpaces BAC's 5.7% marketing expense growth
BA's 2.9% operating margin in 2020 is lower than CAT's 10.3% operating margin
CVX's 2020 production cost of $12.51 per unit is lower than its 2019 cost of $14.51 per unit
GOOGL's expenses may not decrease significantly in the short-term, potentially limiting its ability to match JNJ's 0.6% sales growth.
GS's Consumer & Wealth Management segment saw growth in 2020, while JPM's net revenue growth was only 4%, with a significant increase in provision for credit losses.

KO's net operating revenue growth was impacted by sales volume, price, product and geographic mix, and foreign currency fluctuations, which may not be as favorable as LIN's 13% operating profit growth.

NVDA's Compute & Networking segment gross margin increased 2.5% in 2021, driven by higher margins in Data Center compute systems, while MSFT's gross margin decreased slightly due to sales mix shift to lower margin businesses.

PG's gross margin increased 170 basis points to 53.1% of net sales in Q1 2021, driven by manufacturing cost savings and increased selling prices, while NEE's gross margin decreased in 2020 due to unfavorable foreign exchange impacts.
